_comment: First paid m2 cell (jobs/m2_pilot, DRAFT, NOT SUBMITTED): cache-fork head on the parent the decision tree selects. Same pre-registered shape as the rwkv7 stage-B pilot, plus: train ids only from the PR #16 training pool outside the frozen development cohort (cohort_sha256), eval = the cohort's dev role, and the guard must come from a verified readiness file (require_guard_readiness).
head: fork
max_minutes_note: training wall-clock inside the 95-min cell phase: 95 - smoke 10 - ladder 15 - 5 margin (PR #29 review: max_minutes must be <= the cell cap)

attack_clean.rule: attack_guard/v2: concatenated record text + base64 decodes; 6-gram or exact (4-5 word) fragment, whole-template wildcard (placeholder = 1..30 words, >= 4 fixed words), or fuzzy >= 0.5 of fixed word 3-grams (>= 3); NFKC, Cf removed, Cyrillic+Greek homoglyphs folded, casefold
attack_clean.filter: drop every record with any attack_guard hit (train.attack_guard.record_hits)
